mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, thereby increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved profit outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts and strong consumer spending, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market prices in potential monetary tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts quickly to supply-side strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and consumer spending (as measured by RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand that accelerates economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved near-term earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where the federal funds rate is above 2.0% and inflation is above 3.0%, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market prices in a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
